project_description: We are building a cross-platform Customer Insight Dashboard for internal analytics teams. The platform will aggregate data from multiple upstream systems (including CRM, data warehouse, and internal event streams) to produce unified customer profiles, scoring, and trend analysis. Key risks include inconsistent legacy data schemas, cross-team dependency timelines with Salesforce and Snowflake, security review bottlenecks, and strict performance requirements for near-real-time analytics and dashboard rendering. The system is expected to scale across multiple business units while maintaining data integrity, auditability, and sub-3-second user experience SLAs.
